info.name: ScoopsHub API
info.description:
Official Postman Collection for ScoopsHub REST API (Delivergate Backend Engineer Intern Practical Exam).

### Overview
ScoopsHub is an ice cream parlour management API built with Laravel 13, MySQL, and Laravel Sanctum.

### Getting Started
1. Ensure the local server is running at http://127.0.0.1:8000 (or update base_url).
2. Run the Owner, Manager, and Cashier login requests. Each saves a separate role token.
3. Protected requests explicitly use the role needed for that operation. Creation requests save generated IDs for later requests.
4. Logout is last in the collection.
